## What's new
- Added “New Metalterm Tab Here” and “New Metalterm Window Here” to Finder Services for opening selected folders in an exact terminal working directory. - Added configurable status-bar transitions: sliding path changes, odometer or drop motion for Git counters, and shared horizontal reflow. - Added New Window and New Tab commands to Metalterm’s Dock menu.
## Changed
- Added adjustable 1.0–1.4× line height with a 1.2× default, while keeping emoji, CJK glyphs, and text decorations inside their bounds, sharing pixel-identical atlases, and releasing obsolete ones after regridding. - Updated the status bar promptly after Git branch changes without increasing periodic Git polling.
## Fixed
- Kept native terminal tabs in sync with the selected light or dark terminal theme instead of the macOS appearance. - Clearly separated the renderer's Metal shader version from the GPU's supported Metal family in renderer settings. - Suggested common Git, package, container, cloud, and build-tool subcommands—including nested commands—inline even when they were absent from recent shell history.
- Kept primary-screen coding agent content stable while the agent streams, repaints, and scrolls its transcript. - Kept command gutters uniformly thin, applied theme-correct running and result colours, and stopped them before the empty row separating consecutive commands. - Kept remote SSH tools usable when a server lacks MetalTerm's custom terminfo entry.

## What's new
- Added an Input dock setting that lets new zsh sessions preserve their prompt, line editor, color customizations, and matching top-to-bottom output motion. - Added two-axis pane layouts: split right with `Command+D` or down with `Shift+Command+D`, then navigate, resize, balance, or maximize panes from the keyboard. Split windows also gained a unified header, compact lower panes, stationary text during horizontal divider drags, smooth reflow for width changes, and subtle divider feedback. - Launched a new Metalterm website with verified product details, performance measurements, and clearer installation options. - Added thirteen dark window materials to the appearance picker, completing the designed set of twenty-one: Obsidian Paper, Soft OLED, Volcanic Stone, Graphite Fabric, Liquid Graphite, Soft Touch Polymer, Meteorite Steel, Urushi Nightfall, Charred Oak, Nocturne Velvet, Deep Field, Slate & Vellum and Forged Carbon.
## Changed
- Adjusted the settings layout so controls stay usable at minimum width, deferred-apply hints are clearer and centred, and Input dock offers restart, later, and cancel choices. - Reorganised the appearance picker into `Material` and `Classic` tabs with compact two-line theme cards, so the full set of surfaces fits the window; the Grain and Sheen sliders now follow the Material tab.
## Fixed
- Kept full-screen terminal content below the native tab bar without moving header controls. - Improved tmux integration by preserving pane hyperlinks and working directories and by rendering application-requested cursor colours. - Removed the empty terminal row between command output and the pinned input dock. - Kept the prompt and animated cursor above the status bar during resize and scroll motion. - Kept the view on the prompt when a window or pane changes height with the Input dock on: the latest output stays just above the dock instead of the view drifting up a line per row lost and the prompt slipping out of sight. - Drew a command's echo and output the moment they arrived on a full screen with the Input dock on, instead of only after the next keystroke or scroll.

## Changed
- Local release builds can now create a native app bundle without requiring the other macOS architecture. - Made Metalterm check for updates on launch so available updates appear in Settings without waiting for the daily schedule.
